component.name: X509 Lens
component.summary: Inspect X.509 certificates and cryptographic objects

description.p: X509 Lens is a desktop viewer for certificates, certificate chains, CSRs, CRLs, PKCS#7 and PKCS#12 bundles, and public key metadata.
It compares server-presented chains with host trust resolution and provides fingerprints, SPKI details, extension decoding, and ASN.1 views.
